question: A conveyor motor accelerates a 45 kg crate. The acceleration, in m/s², is set by taking the number of ways to choose 4 items from 6, adding 23, and then adding 28. The crate is 1.1 m wide. The force required is reported in kilonewtons. The plant runs 9 such conveyors from one power unit. What total force, in kN, must the power unit supply?

A 32 kg buoy is towed by a survey boat at a speed, in m/s, that is 5 times the smaller root of x² - 8x + 12 = 0. The survey area covers 3 km². The boat tows 11 identical buoys per pass, makes 4 passes per survey, and completes 10 surveys in a season. What is the total energy of motion, in J, of all the buoys across the season?

A 14 000 g projectile is launched at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 2x² + 7x from x = 2 to x = 4. The barrel is 1.6 m long. The projectile's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules, and 7 kJ is deducted for air drag over the flight. The range fires 12 shots per session and holds 2 sessions. What is the total energy, in kJ, delivered at the targets over the 2 sessions?

A stadium's turf crew wants the combined force, in kilonewtons, for 3 pitches, each pushed by 12 identical rollers at once, with each pitch's total stated in kilonewtons. Each roller has a mass of 190 kg. Its acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 4 crew members from 8. What is the combined force, in kN?

A fleet controller wants the total force, in newtons, needed when 11 regions, each with 12 depots, each with 8 sites, each with 12 identical carts, all accelerate their carts at once. Each cart has a mass of 79 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², is the larger root of x² - 6x + 8 = 0. What total force, in N, is needed?

A theme-park engineer is summing a figure, in kilojoules, for 4 identical model log-flume boats. Each boat's contribution is its energy of motion at the bottom of the drop, less 28 J lost to splash, expressed in kilojoules. Each model boat has a mass of 40 000 g and the flume channel is 1.5 m wide. The boat's speed at the bottom, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. What is the summed figure, in kJ?

A 113 000 g cargo pod is accelerated along a launch rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 2x³ + 4x² is itself changing at x = 2. The rail's motor must also overcome 24 N of guide friction and 10 N of air drag. The motor's total force is expressed in kilonewtons, and a 28 kN safety margin is added for the rating. What is the rating, in kN?

A dockyard foreman wants the total winch force, in newtons, for a job: the force for 6 identical pallets moving at once, plus 30 N for the winch's own drum friction. Each pallet's force is what is needed to accelerate its 178 kg mass, plus 23 N to overcome its skid friction. The pallets are 1.2 m square. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 85 and 230. What is the total winch force, in N?

A haulage depot is reporting the total force, in newtons, for a day's work: 9 identical trucks' worth, plus 15 N for a tailgate lift, minus 6 N recovered by a ramp. Each truck's share is the force needed to accelerate its 156 kg test load, less 3 N supplied by a slope. The load's acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 3x from x = 0 to x = 3. What is the total force, in N?

A tram engineer needs the final force rating, in kilonewtons, for a bogie: the force to accelerate a 121 000 g test carriage, less 6 N recovered by a regenerative unit, plus 26 N for coupler drag, expressed in kilonewtons. The acceleration, in m/s², is 21 more than the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 6x from x = 2 to x = 4. What is the final rating, in kN?

A mine shift boss wants the net force, in newtons, that a cart motor actually supplies. It is the force needed to accelerate an 89 kg cart, reduced by 27 N provided by a downhill grade and by a further 23 N from a tailwind in the tunnel. The cart's acceleration, in m/s², is 7 times the smaller root of x² - 7x + 6 = 0. What net force, in N, does the motor supply?

A rail depot wants the combined force, in kilonewtons, needed to start 9 identical model wagons at once. Each model wagon has a mass of 138 000 g. The wagons' acceleration, in m/s², is obtained by doubling the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 3x from x = 0 to x = 3 and then subtracting 15. What is the combined force, in kN?

A dock crew needs the total force, in kilonewtons, for 6 identical cargo sleds pulled at once, each sled's force being stated in kilonewtons. Each sled's force is what is needed to accelerate its 52 000 g mass, less 11 N supplied by a tide-assisted slope. The sleds' acceleration, in m/s², is found by multiplying the sum of 7 and 4 by 3 and then subtracting 24. What is the total force, in kN?

A 45 000 g barrel rolls along a brewery floor at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 10x + 21 = 0. The barrel holds 60 L. As it rolls it loses 7 J of its energy of motion to a floor seam and 8 J to a drain grate, then gains 30 J from a push. Express the barrel's resulting energy of motion in kJ.

A quarry manager is rating a fleet of 8 identical dumpers: the fleet rating, in kilonewtons, is 8 times the net figure for one dumper. That net figure is the force for the dumper's 8 axle-modules moving together, expressed in kilonewtons, minus 30 kN recovered by the engine brake. Each axle-module has a mass of 55 000 g. The acceleration, in m/s², is 3 times the sum of 8 and 16. What is the fleet rating, in kN?

A lab technician reports a total energy, in joules, for a puck experiment: 19 J stored in the launcher spring, plus the combined energy of 7 identical pucks. Each puck's energy is its energy of motion plus 16 J from a magnetic kick. Each puck has a mass of 3 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 77 and 12. What is the total energy, in J?

A 7 000 g drone is pushed forward by its rotors with an acceleration, in m/s², equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 12 = 0. The forward force from the rotors is expressed in kilonewtons. A 24 kN backward tether tension is then applied to the drone. The test uses 6 identical drones per rig and 12 rigs. What is the net forward force, in kN, across all the drones, with backward forces counted as negative?

A crane depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 10 identical hoists lifting at once, each stated in kilonewtons. Each hoist accelerates a 115 kg load, with gravity balanced by a counterweight. The load's cable is 18 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², is 21 more than the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 4x² is itself changing at x = 1. What is the total force, in kN?

A workshop foreman reports the total force, in newtons, on a bench rig: 19 N from a final clamp, 1 N from a sensor spring, 6 N from a cable, and the force for 12 identical sliders accelerating at once. Each slider has a mass of 21 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 222 and 215. What is the total force, in N?

A physics teacher is compiling a final figure, in kilojoules: 13 kJ for the launcher's stored energy, plus the combined energy of motion of 12 identical carts, each expressed in kilojoules. Each cart has a mass of 6 000 g and the track is 4 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 4x² is itself changing at x = 1. What is the final figure, in kJ?

A 14 kg sled is accelerated forward at a rate, in m/s², equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. The sled is 1.2 m long. The forward force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 5 identical sleds are linked. A 12 kN backward brake force is then applied to the linked group, followed by a 19 kN forward push from a booster. What is the net forward force, in kN, on the group?

A courier firm is summing the energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 9 vans, each carrying 8 identical parcels, with each van's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each parcel has a mass of 7 000 g. Each parcel's speed, in m/s, is 6 more than the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 3x² at x = 1. What is the summed energy of motion, in kJ?

A 56 000 g motorbike-and-rider test mass moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 15. The test track is 800 m long. The lab runs 2 identical test masses at once, then adds 27 J from a tailwind, 23 J from a downhill section, and 3 J from a push. What is the combined energy of motion, in J?

A safety consultant is totalling the energy of motion, in joules, of 5 groups of 9 identical crash sleds. Each sled's figure is its energy of motion, less 4 J lost to rail friction and 23 J lost to air drag. Each sled has a mass of 55 000 g. Its speed, in m/s, is 3 times the sum of 9 and 5. What is the total energy of motion, in J?

A 31 000 g crate rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 271 and 241. Its energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kilojoules. The warehouse moves 7 identical crates at once, and a lift adds 19 kJ to the combined figure. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
